name: open-code-review
description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
one_liner: An automatic code reviewer that reads every pull request and leaves line-by-line comments catching bugs and security holes, combining fixed rule checks with an AI that reads the actual logic.
buyer: An engineering manager at a 20-200 person software company who wants consistent, fast code review without hiring more senior reviewers.
business_use_cases: A startup wires it into GitHub as a required CI check so every PR gets an automatic security and quality pass before a human even looks at it.
An outsourced dev shop uses it to raise the baseline quality of contractor-written code before it ships to clients.
A fintech's compliance team uses its built-in SQL-injection/XSS ruleset to produce an auditable record that every merged change was security-scanned.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as a hosted SaaS (connect your repo, no Go/infra setup) and charge per seat or per repo
Offer a managed install + custom ruleset service for companies that want it self-hosted but don't want to configure it themselves

steal_this: Package it as a one-click GitHub Marketplace app this weekend: free tier for public repos, paid tier for private ones, undercutting hosted AI-code-review SaaS competitors on price since the underlying engine is already free and open source.
